<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-beasties-container>
  <head>
    <base href="/">
    <title>Spectrum.net</title>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, minimum-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
    <meta name="description" content="Sign in to your Spectrum account for the easiest way to view and pay your bill, watch TV, manage your account and more.">
    <link rel="icon" id="specnetFavicon" href="/favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon">
    <!-- Index Scripts -->
    <script>
      (function () {
        window.localStorage.setItem('appInitTimestamp', new Date().valueOf().toString());
      })();
    </script>
    <script src="./shared-assets/akamai.js" fetchpriority="high"></script>
    <script src="./shared-assets/tealium.js" defer></script>
    <script src="./shared-assets/asapp.js" defer></script>
    <style>
      @keyframes initLoader {
        0% {
          transform: rotate(220deg);
          stroke-dashoffset: 66%;
        }

        50% {
          transform: rotate(740deg);
          stroke-dashoffset: 296%;
        }

        100% {
          transform: rotate(940deg);
          stroke-dashoffset: 66%;
        }
      }

      .init-loader-container {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        height: 100vh;
        width: 100vw;
      }

      svg.init-ngk-loader {
        background: transparent;
        z-index: 1;
        animation: fade-in 0.75s ease-in-out;
        transition-delay: 0s;
      }

      svg.init-ngk-loader circle {
        fill: transparent;
        stroke: var(--kite-color-primary);
        transform-origin: center;
        transform: rotate(-90deg);
      }

      svg.init-ngk-loader circle.init-ngk-spin {
        animation: initLoader 1.4s linear infinite;
      }

      .welcome-screen {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        text-align: center;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
      }

      .welcome-screen-header {
        height: 2.5rem;
        width: 12.5rem;
        display: flex;
        position: absolute;
        top: 20%;
        transform: translate(-50%, -100%);
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: flex-start;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .welcome-screen-header > img {
        width: 12.5rem;
      }
    </style>

<html lang="en" data-beasties-container>
  <head>
    <base href="/">
    <title>Spectrum.net</title>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, minimum-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
    <meta name="description" content="Sign in to your Spectrum account for the easiest way to view and pay your bill, watch TV, manage your account and more.">
    <link rel="icon" id="specnetFavicon" href="/favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon">
    <!-- Index Scripts -->
    <script>
      (function () {
        window.localStorage.setItem('appInitTimestamp', new Date().valueOf().toString());
      })();
    </script>
    <script src="./shared-assets/akamai.js" fetchpriority="high"></script>
    <script src="./shared-assets/tealium.js" defer></script>
    <script src="./shared-assets/asapp.js" defer></script>
    <style>
      @keyframes initLoader {
        0% {
          transform: rotate(220deg);
          stroke-dashoffset: 66%;
        }

        50% {
          transform: rotate(740deg);
          stroke-dashoffset: 296%;
        }

        100% {
          transform: rotate(940deg);
          stroke-dashoffset: 66%;
        }
      }

      .init-loader-container {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        height: 100vh;
        width: 100vw;
      }

      svg.init-ngk-loader {
        background: transparent;
        z-index: 1;
        animation: fade-in 0.75s ease-in-out;
        transition-delay: 0s;
      }

      svg.init-ngk-loader circle {
        fill: transparent;
        stroke: var(--kite-color-primary);
        transform-origin: center;
        transform: rotate(-90deg);
      }

      svg.init-ngk-loader circle.init-ngk-spin {
        animation: initLoader 1.4s linear infinite;
      }

      .welcome-screen {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        text-align: center;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
      }

      .welcome-screen-header {
        height: 2.5rem;
        width: 12.5rem;
        display: flex;
        position: absolute;
        top: 20%;
        transform: translate(-50%, -100%);
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: flex-start;
        text-align: center;
      }

      .welcome-screen-header > img {
        width: 12.5rem;
      }
    </style>
